Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)
Class: EQ Assault Rifle
Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Battle Barrel, Constant Recoil System, Flared Magwell (w/ Drum Magazine), Infrared Nightvision Scope, Power Rebuild, Improved Silencer (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Single Shot fires a 3-round burst whose rounds also count as Armor-Piercing, and it won't fire with fewer than 3 loaded. Listeners take -2 to Perception to hear it fire (Improved Silencer). Without BODY 10+ or paired Cyberarms, the wielder takes -1 DEX and MOVE.

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
